about: Card 10A-1: inclusion lines written by lane J's reviewer before reading this card's table (unseen at design): the lines the reviewer's second review reported (17 negated lines that ran as presence, the cue-less absence words, and one over-hold with its English and Chinese equivalents). The reviewer's full set of 154 lines is not in this repository. Synthetic; no patient data. Fields as in lines.json. 'over_held' marks a must-run row the fail-safe holds today (the target of card 10A-1b): the 19 lines lane J's reviewer reported as newly over-held and one of its 40 fresh lines, verbatim, with the coded concept the reviewer named.

rows.text: Treatment-naive with respect to tyrosine kinase inhibitors.
The patient, in the opinion of the investigator and after review of all available medical records, has not at any time before enrolment in this study been exposed to bevacizumab.
Patients may not have had any previous exposure, whether as monotherapy or as part of a combination regimen given in any line, to an EGFR inhibitor.
Insulin has never been administered.
Patients who have received prior docetaxel are not eligible.
ベバシズマブによる前治療歴が、同意取得時点までの診療録を確認した範囲において一切存在しないこと。

心房細動(AF)を合併していない。
化學治療:未曾接受。
HIV感染檢測為陰性。
Patients must not have a prior or concurrent diagnosis of any other invasive malignancy.
Must not have previously received treatment with any investigational anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody.
Prior radiotherapy (RT) is not permitted.
Chemotherapy (CT) has not been given.
Chemotherapy must not have been given within 4 weeks.
受試者未曾於任何醫療機構接受過任何形式之化學治療。
化学療法を、いかなる時点においても、受けていないこと。
Ex-smoker
Abstinent from alcohol

治療歴ゼロ
化学療法後に増悪が認められない患者。
No progression after chemotherapy.
化學治療後未見惡化。
Must have received prior chemotherapy with no dose reductions.
